description: Counts and shares, not a list: for the sites matching a filter, how many use each technology, grouped by kind (payments, analytics, hosting, cms...). Answers any question of the form 'how many', 'what share', or 'which X do sites using Y use' in one call, for example 'what payment providers do Ghost sites use'. Use this BEFORE find_sites or export_sites for those questions; exporting rows and counting them costs hundreds of lookups for the same answer. Same filters as find_sites. Counts one Explore slice and no site allowance.

category.description: Product category of the SITES, e.g. ecommerce. Not a kind of technology; for that see technologyCategory.

country.description: Country as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. GB. Names are accepted too. Country is an ESTIMATE with a confidence score, so see minCountryConfidence.

keywords.description: Whole words to look for in a site's name, title or description, e.g. photogrammetry. Matches ANY of them; a multi-word entry is a phrase. Three characters or more, up to ten words. Combines with every other filter, so 'Stripe sites that mention photogrammetry' is technology plus keywords. The same rule create_watch uses, so a word that filters here is the word a watch would fire on.

minCountryConfidence.description: Least country confidence to accept, 0 to 1. Pass 0.6 when the country needs to be right rather than merely likely.

near.description: Only sites near a place: a town or city, a postcode, or 'lat,lng', e.g. Bristol. Use with radius. Sites we could not place are left out.

observedSince.description: Earliest date we first recorded the site, YYYY-MM-DD.

radius.description: How far from near, e.g. 30mi or 50km (a bare number is km). From 5 to 248 miles (8 to 400 km).

technology.description: Technology name, exactly as returned by list_technologies, e.g. ghost. The sites using it are the population; it is left out of its own breakdown.

technologyCategory.description: One kind of technology to report on, e.g. payments, analytics, cms, hosting. Leave unset for every kind. list_technologies shows each technology's kind under 'category'.

until.description: Latest LAUNCH date, YYYY-MM-DD. Inclusive of the whole day.
